content: {"paper_id":"W4386798142","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"deep-clustering","exact_quote":"the objective of node representation learning is jointly optimized with the self-supervised clustering objective to obtain cluster distributions and discriminative node representations simultaneously","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文将可学习的节点表示学习目标与自监督聚类目标联合优化，同时得到簇分布和判别性节点表示，属于利用神经表示和聚类目标获得数据划分的深度聚类。"},{"keyword_id":"contrastive-learning","exact_quote":"Then, a multilevel contrastive mechanism is proposed to maximize the agreement between node representations in multiple latent spaces.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"提出多层级对比机制，在多个潜在空间中最大化节点表示之间的一致性，符合通过视图或表示间吸引与区分目标学习表示的定义。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"we construct a contrasting view based on the generated k NN graph and edge betweenness centrality to preserve the inherent cluster structure of a graph","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文基于生成的kNN图和边介数中心性构造对比视图以保持簇结构，涉及对样本间边或图结构的构造与修正，属于图结构学习。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
